description: Anonymised extract of gate test 2 (CRO-22), for replay tests (CRO-33). Times are ms relative to the first event of each part. Var names, values and edges only; no names, ids, codes, paths or URLs.

fd_burst.note: Edges the guest received for 9 + 1 host presses of FD (cause D). At +531 ms a down edge found the guest value still odd because the previous up write was not read back yet: one press was lost and acked ok.

idg.note: Values the host sent for IDG 1 clicks (cause A): a counter, +1 per press and +1 per release. The guest accepted the first value (1 = held down) and refused the rest.

blue_pump.note: Host values of BLUE ELEC PUMP (cause B): a 0/1 latch, not a counter.

unpowered.note: Session start, the guest FCU was unpowered (cold and dark): the server corrected +900 clicks six times, nothing moved.

powered.note: Later, both powered: the corrections wrote +1000, -37100 and +11800 clicks; the display slammed between 100 and 49000.

phantom_turn.note: Four host clicks the guest applied 20-44 ms apart (cause F). The guest read back an in-between value of its own write and sent it back to the host as a pilot turn (+1).

apu_reset.note: Guest side of cause C: host edges as they arrived (remote, edge, gap_ms) and the guest pilot clicking the same button (local_step: +1 each). Fenix only adds 1, so the guest ended with the button resting odd (stuck pressed) for 84 minutes.

panel_real_red.note: CRO-34: the only controls the panel may show red in the gate test 2 replay, each a real, lasting difference a pilot could fix (docs/gate-tests/CRO-22-gate-test-2.md sections 2 and 3). Peak was 19 red cards at 20:08.

controls.E_FCU_ALTITUDE: ALT display 100 vs 1000 after the guest FCU powered up, later 11900 vs 49000 (diagnosis 0.3, F)
controls.E_FCU_VS: V/S display differed after the corrections (F)
controls.E_FCU_HEADING: HDG display differed for a minute after the FD burst (E/F)
controls.E_FCU_SPEED: SPD managed differed after the FD burst (mode)
controls.S_OH_APU_AUTOEXTING_RESET: two pilots on one counter: held down in the guest cockpit for 84 min (C)
controls.S_OH_ELEC_IDG1: deny list: pressed on the host, not mirrored (A)
controls.S_OH_ELEC_IDG2: deny list: pressed on the host, not mirrored (A)
controls.S_FCU_EFIS1_FD: press lost in the FD burst (D)
controls.S_FCU_EFIS1_LS: press lost, LS lit in one cockpit (D)
controls.S_FCU_EFIS2_LS: press lost, LS lit in one cockpit (D)
controls.ecam_page: ECAM page differed for 14 s (ALL pressed during the burst)

panel_stream.note: CRO-34: what the guest bridge received in gate test 2 (89 min), for the panel replay. Events: [t, "d", var, reason, tier, expected, observed, pf, pm, who, group] desync opened; [t, "c", var, reason] desync cleared; [t, "a", key, kind, active, var, label, seat, count] advisory; [t, "m", var] a pilot moved or pressed it (sent or applied); [t, "v", var, value] this cockpit's FCU/RMP power flag or mode lamp changed; [t, "x", var, pf, pm] a snapshot diff showed it differ. who: the client_id of the desync, self = this bridge. Replayed as it was (protocol v3, bridge 0.3.2).
